# JetBrains Marketplace Store Description

## HTML Description (for `<description>` tag in plugin.xml)

```html
<h2>Dead Code & Drift Radar — Find Forgotten Code Before It Becomes Debt</h2>

<p>Identify abandoned, drifting, and dead code in your project using git history and static analysis. 
Every file gets a drift score (0-100) so you know exactly what's actively maintained and what's rotting.</p>

<h3>Core Features</h3>
<ul>
    <li><b>Drift Score</b> — 0-100 health metric combining git history and reference analysis</li>
    <li><b>Gutter Icons</b> — Color-coded indicators (🟢 Active, 🟡 Drifting, 🔴 Abandoned)</li>
    <li><b>Hover Tooltips</b> — Author, last change, reference count, and drift breakdown</li>
    <li><b>Project View Badges</b> — See drift status without opening files</li>
    <li><b>Configurable Thresholds</b> — Define your own standards for drift boundaries</li>
</ul>

<h3>Pro Features ($3.90/month)</h3>
<ul>
    <li>Method-level drift scores</li>
    <li>Project heatmap visualization</li>
    <li>Trend analysis and cleanup backlog</li>
    <li>Zombie and orphan code detection</li>
    <li>Safe-to-remove confidence scores</li>
    <li>Export reports (SARIF, JUnit XML)</li>
    <li>CI integration via Gradle task</li>
</ul>

<h3>Requirements</h3>
<ul>
    <li>IntelliJ IDEA 2024.1+ (or any JetBrains IDE)</li>
    <li>Git repository</li>
</ul>

<h3>Support</h3>
<p>
    <a href="#">Documentation</a> |
    <a href="#">Issue Tracker</a> |
    <a href="#">Contact Support</a>
</p>
```

## Summary

**Tagline:** Find forgotten code before it becomes technical debt.

**Short Description (200 chars):** Identify dead and drifting code using git history and static analysis. Drift scores, gutter icons, heatmaps, and cleanup backlog. Free core + Pro at $3.90/mo.
